name: print-social-dark-interior-property-post-with-frosted-cards
title: Property post over a dim luxury living room with two frosted glass cards
whatItIs: A tall photo of a cream sofa and marble floor in a moodily lit room. A large frosted card at top holds the bold white title 'THE SHORELINE' and a two-line subhead; a smaller frosted card at the bottom shows price per square metre and city.
whatItMeans: Calm, upscale and quiet; glass cards keep the photograph legible and elegant.
techniques: Use two frosted glass panels, top and bottom, to frame a photo.
Set the title in bold caps and the subhead in light weight.
Choose a warm low-light interior photograph.
Keep only one line of price info.

vocabulary.definition: A blurred translucent rectangle laid over an image.
A bold heading with a lighter descriptive line.
A short line stating cost and place.
